correctness.rationale: The exact source multiplication and twist were inspected. For R=[[x,y],[z,w]], twist commutation gives (lambda-1)y=(lambda-1)z=0. Evaluating bilinear RB product defect on basis pairs yields equations x²+2lambda yz=0, z(lambda(x-w)-x)=0, lambda y(w+x)=0, lambda w²+(1-lambda)yz=0, (2lambda-1)y²=0. If lambda !=1, y=z=x=0 and lambda w²=0. If lambda=1, w=y=x=0 and z free. Thus exactly the three cases and 3q-2 pairs. Source Example2.2 map R(e1)=b e2 satisfies product equations always but fails Ralpha=alphaR unless (lambda-1)b=0; original Definition1.3 includes compatibility. Independently enumerated complete 2x2 maps over F3 and F5, reproducing distributions [q at 0,q at 1,one elsewhere]. Symbolic proof works over every field of char !=2; finite tests are only checks.
residual_risks: The char=2 degenerate algebra is excluded and cannot be inferred.
